title: MV Custom Menu Backgrounds for each actor?

posts.author: Hyper_kat7
posts.body:
I'm making my first project in RPG maker MV. I've created full body art of the main four party members for my game, and I want there to be some way to see this art within the game.
Near the very start when I made the project, I downloaded the
Menu Backgrounds plugin
by SomeRandomDude, so that I could have the backgrounds for the pause menus be all black. I see there's a way to have a different image for the status screen, but I want there to be unique backgrounds for the status screen of each actor. Is there a way to do that with this plugin? If not, is there a way to do that with some other plugin? ( Also, I don't have money to buy plugins ;-; )
I'd very much appreciate some help and/or advice, thank you.

posts.author: rpgLord69
Hyper_kat7
utunnels

posts.body:
A common approach would be to attach a load listener to the bitmap and blt it within the callback rather than right away.
For more flexibility, just add the image as a custom sprite.

posts.body:
keep in mind that there can be 1 major drawback here as well and need
a fallback if it fails to load.
for example, your player can rename the actor, so this actor name doesn't
exist, so it must use the drawback.
another idea is maybe longer, which require more the ID for the actor
instead of using it's name.
this way, its safer and might better work as well
if it also depends on the class, than ID's is the best way to go with.
